Notes: Two floors of tables and nobody counting how long you stay.
Gate is open dawn to dusk and the benches face away from the road.
Cool and silent on a hot afternoon; nobody asks anything of you.
Movable chairs on every level and it stays open late.
You can sit with your own sandwich if you pick the right end.
A room designed for staying still
Six benches in a row means you can always find one alone.
Tea urn at the back and no one minds if you only came for the warm.
Twenty minutes is comfortable; an hour starts to feel odd.
Nobody checks whether you belong to the university.
